title: Answer support tickets the support lead's way
when: answering the day's customer support tickets in tickets.csv (refunds, cancellations, late orders, complaints), with the orders in orders.csv, before the replies go out
request: Today is 2026-10-31. Answer the support tickets in tickets.csv (orders in orders.csv; the data is fictitious). Write replies.json with: tickets (one per ticket: {"ticket_id", "decision": "refund" | "no_refund" | "credit" | "escalate" | "inform", "refund_amount" (number, 0 when none), "tag", "reply" (the text sent to the customer)}) and escalations (list of ticket_ids for the support lead), and REPLIES.md, a short summary for the support lead.
